$comment: Starter harness profiles. A syndicate channel names one (channels[].harness_profile); limits omitted here fall to the harness block of etc/agency.json.

data.label: Read-only filesystem
data.description: Read, list, glob, and search files under the mission working directory. The loop limits of etc/agency.json.

data.label: Read-only filesystem, compact context
data.description: As readonly_fs, sized for channels with 32k-token windows: fewer calls per turn and smaller results, so one turn of reads cannot fill the window (observed on mux_nova, which read every file at once and lost the question).

data.label: Read-only shell (staged)
data.description: The read-only filesystem functions plus the starter command allowlist. The commands are inert until a Shell function exists and the operator has reviewed command_policy.

data.label: Read-only filesystem + agency CLI, compact context
data.description: readonly_fs_compact plus the Agency function: a 32k-window channel can inspect the agency and compose records by dry run (agent generate, data new --dry-run). Missions still name the functions they use (--tools / --toolset); a channel on this profile serves read-only missions exactly as before.
